book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: Hillya ki Yesu Ge' mi'mǝshti
Nǝ cin shuti ɓe u, Malyamu Magadaliya, nǝ Malyamu dya ki Yakubu, nǝ Salomi, is ul mil ki tukǝni dli mul tǝmti, gaki sǝlle' tukǝ dli ki Yesu.
Gas cin ki kina ki shuti, a bilucili petito' kǝccin is lǝge'lu u nǝs gutiɗa u.
Asi tǝn shitu is ngem yelsǝnisu, “Okǝn jakǝnimmin yegǝn u taka ɗǝbi shu ki gum mbalǝn u?”
Nǝs tlil ga lya u, is yeni, a jakǝn yegǝni taka malgǝni i, in ngu, balini.
Sisu'ge'lu gum mbalǝni, is yen yakǝn giɗǝnsiwon ki dǝmi tǝn toh shimti, ki dlili nǝ hwol lulǝgǝl. Is kum ɓanti.
Tine i'ulsisu, “Bǝ kumǝn ɓantwai. Yesu mul Nazalat kǝnki ngauhtiya? Gunǝs tolti tǝn gadlǝnngawa? Ta hilya tiɗawai. Yenǝn lu u nes la'ti ɗa u!
Nǝgun u zǝnga ki dlimi mil kushtiwasi, nǝ Bitlus, ‘Yesu yinǝn ngǝltikin nǝ mbǝkǝshti a Galili, tyaka ki yenǝnti kǝnǝ kan u nǝ' dlimikini u.’ ”
I mudliyi pe'nǝ kitǝl, uli a hwossi i asi nepti ki dli. Sa ul mulǝnsu ulǝnwai, gaki sikub ɓanti.
I Yesu Mbǝl Gawas ma' Malyamu Magadaliya
Nǝ Yesu hilya ge' mi'mǝshtu nǝ kyeu gascin kǝkina ki shuti, im mbǝl gawas ma' Malyamu ki Magadala, kǝli u nǝ Yesu pe'kǝli' mi'gatli ningi u.
Tine is zǝga ille'dlǝmi mbalǝnyi nǝ, sine' Yesu teɗu, ginǝ si du mbadli, asi kulu.
Nǝs kumi Yesu a mǝci ta hilya u, tima kǝliyi i'enti, sine sala' mbatl nǝtiwai.
Yesu Mbǝl Gawas ma' Mil kushtiwasi Lop
Kalki nǝgu i Yesu bǝ gedli kishoti Immbǝl gawasi ma' mbalǝn yen'lob age' mil kushtiwasi asi lǝti ge' ya'kǝn gatlon.
I lopi paltya is dlimi na yelsǝniyi nǝ sine' siyi, is nge nditi nǝ dlimtiwasǝn.
Kyautǝn u nǝ Yesu Bǝl Mil kushtiwasu
Age' kale immbǝl gawas ma'kutl nǝ nǝmisi, sigawasǝn, nǝsi ɗamti u. Immatisi tǝn ngela'ti mbadlwasǝn nǝ ndilkǝ gawasǝn, sa ndi'nǝ ginǝ yen hillya wasuwai.
I'ulsisu, “Zǝnga ge'dǝplǝɓa, ki'dlǝmi mus mbalǝn shilǝn ki Lya.
Mus ginǝ ala'mbadlu, i pǝlisi baptisma u, sǝm mbi' pe'ti. Mulnǝ a nge la'ti mbadlu tǝkǝn mbi' pe'twai.
Nǝn ye' ulki gagashinti ma' mi'la'ti mbadli, nǝ shinyikǝn sǝppekkǝl mi'gatli, sǝn shilǝnti nǝ undi biyen,
Sǝmma' ka' uci nǝ toh, sǝmma' tle' byaslǝɓa, kǝn pǝlissi ulǝnwai, sǝmma'zǝ' mil gottoh as ndoki.”
Akan Yesu Twa lyayi
Ge' kalki Yesu apa pissi shilǝn i, is kanti twalya, iddǝm tǝn toshipki Lya.
I mil kushtiwas peki, is go'dlǝb shilǝnki Lya, a Lya go' ɗǝtl isi, is mani bali shilǝn u nǝ' dlimisi u tu'tǝn ye'gagashintu nǝsi pǝli.
